senses.gloss:
Kīṭa is the name of a species of worm mentioned in the Atharvaveda, and frequently in the Upaniṣads.
Foot notes ix. 4, 16.
Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, vi. 1, 19; 2, 14; Chāndogya upaniṣad, vi. 9. 3; 10, 2; vii. 2, 1; 7, 1; kauṣītaki upaniṣad, i. 2, etc.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 98.
